prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1096; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on a roadway in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing right before the impact?

A: I was heading east on a main road, stopped in traffic at a light. I had come to a complete stop and was waiting for the light to change.

Q: What happened next?

A: The next thing I knew, I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. My car was pushed into the vehicle in front of me.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, I didn't. I was looking ahead at the light and I never saw it coming in the mirror.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, I got out. The driver of the other car came over and we spoke briefly. Nobody was seriously hurt that I could tell at the scene.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?

A: Yes. My neck is sore and stiff, mostly on the left side. It hurts more when I turn my head to check my blind spot, and I've had some headaches at the base of my skull.

Q: Have you sought medical care for these symptoms?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Are you currently receiving any ongoing treatment?

A: I have a follow-up appointment scheduled with my doctor next week, and I'm doing some gentle stretching at home.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this taken care of and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
